title: Servers and installing
intro:
The Corp's cards live in servers. HQ (your hand), R&D (your deck) and Archives (your discard pile) are the three central servers; every other card you install goes into a remote server you create. An installed card is face down until you rez it by paying its rez cost — the Runner can see that something is there, but not what.

Nico Campaign is an asset: rezzed, it pays you 3 credits at the start of each of your turns.

This lesson: install Nico Campaign into a new remote and rez it.
outro: Remote servers are where agendas get scored and where assets like Nico Campaign earn. Anything in a remote can be run at, so the next lesson puts ice in front of it.

steps.prose: Install Nico Campaign from HQ into a new remote server. Installing a card there is what creates the server, and this one will be called Remote 0.
steps.hint: Install Nico Campaign in a new remote server.

steps.prose: It is face down. Rez it now for 2 credits so it starts paying next turn — rezzing does not cost a click.
Spend any clicks you have left, then end your turn.
